items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: my mother used to tell us about Buddy Bolden, how he used to play the horn

ctx.x: Why did you get it? money. I mean, why did you?

Well, I always wanted to play a trumpet. Louis Armstrong inspired me very much and they had other trumpet players like my mother used to tell us about Buddy Bolden, how he used to play the horn and how for my, for many blocks around you could hear him playing. And so, I've always wanted to play some kind of instrument.
